selection.tuned_is_optimistic: selected and evaluated on the same 32 shards; quote the held-out or pre-registerable row instead

pre_registerable.rule: largest swept clip <= the no-infinity bound
pre_registerable.why: this rule never looks at a coverage number, so it carries no selection effect at all

why_excluded: operator shifts change p(y|x); weighted conformal's covariate-shift assumption does not hold there and no clip repairs that
